_note: Curated reference coordinates for the 8 North Eastern Region states: one entry per district, at the district headquarters town. Coordinates were resolved from OpenStreetMap for each HQ town (with state disambiguation) and cross-checked against state government district lists; entries where Nominatim returns an administrative centroid instead of the town carry an explicit curated override (e.g. Mangan town per SSDMA, Mon town per OSM town node). Used as a geocoding fallback and as spatial anchors for district-level flood/landslide records that lack coordinates. Additional curated demo entries (real towns/villages beyond the district HQ list) are appended per state and carry a source beginning 'Curated demo place' so demo lookups resolve deterministically without a network geocoder.
